coverage.note: gold units lacking >=1 of the 12 judge verdicts (API subset coverage)

exchangeability.assumption: zone miss-rate numbers are conditional on the adjudicated gold sample
exchangeability.gold_construction: disagreement-enriched sampling (v1 100D/50A vicuna; v3 33D/17A qwen) + author/adjudicated labels; v2 convenience layer excluded
exchangeability.direction_of_bias: enrichment inflates judge disagreement vs the full grid; prevalence (0.29) exceeds the full-grid positive rate, so zone sizes and miss risks do NOT transfer unmodified to deployment distributions
exchangeability.required_claim_wording: report as 'on the adjudicated gold sample', never as distribution-free guarantees over the full grid

zero_miss_note.rule_of_three: 0 misses in n units -> one-sided 95% upper bound 3/n
zero_miss_note.wording: bottom-30% auto-negative zone showed 0/78 misses: upper 95% bound ~3.8% among auto-negatived units (zone denominator); NOT a guarantee

split_half.design: choose zone size on half A (zero-miss criterion), evaluate on held-out half B with the A-trained model
split_half.post_hoc_disclosure: v1 zone boundaries (30/40) were selected after viewing the triage curve on the same 261 units; the split-half above is the honest replication

k3_distribution.note: selection over 220 subsets inflates the reported max by ~the winner's curse delta (nested vs naive)
